title.zh-CN: 花园蜇伤后呼吸困难 · 30岁女性
title.en: Breathless after a sting in the garden · 30-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 午后的医院疗愈花园里，一位来探视家属的年轻女性在长椅旁突然不适。你和带着病区急救包赶来的护士一起，在没有抢救室设备的户外完成快速评估与处理，随后安排转运、检查与去向。
summary.en: On an afternoon in the hospital's healing garden, a young woman visiting a relative is suddenly unwell beside a bench. With a ward nurse who has run over with the emergency bag, you must assess and treat her outdoors — with no resus-room equipment — then arrange transfer, tests and disposition.

notes.zh-CN: 完全虚构的教学病例，按RCUK 2021、WAO 2020、EAACI 2021等指南编写；人物均为化名，不对应任何真实患者。
notes.en: Entirely fictional teaching case written to RCUK 2021, WAO 2020 and EAACI 2021 guidance; all names are pseudonyms and no real patient is depicted.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 虚构教学病例，不构成医疗建议。
disclaimer.en: Fictional teaching case — not medical advice.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 花园里被蜜蜂蜇后全身痒、喉咙发紧、头晕
chiefComplaint.en: Itchy all over, tight throat and dizzy after a bee sting in the garden

triageNote.zh-CN: 15:40，疗愈花园长椅旁。30岁女性访客，约8分钟前右前臂被蜇，随后全身起疹、嘴唇肿、声音嘶哑、喘、头晕。我带着病区急救包到场，便携设备测得：血压78/44 mmHg，心率128次/分，呼吸26次/分，SpO₂ 92%（空气）。
triageNote.en: 15:40, beside a bench in the healing garden. 30-year-old woman, a visitor, stung on the right forearm about 8 minutes ago; since then rash all over, swollen lips, hoarse voice, wheezy and dizzy. I've brought the ward emergency bag; portable readings: BP 78/44 mmHg, HR 128/min, RR 26/min, SpO₂ 92% on air.

personality.zh-CN: 平时开朗、有条理的中学音乐老师；此刻非常害怕，但尽力配合。
personality.en: Normally cheerful and organised secondary-school music teacher; terrified right now but trying hard to cooperate.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 声音嘶哑，每次只能说两三个词到一个短句，常停下来喘气；用词口语化。
speechStyle.en: Hoarse; manages two or three words to one short sentence at a time, stopping for breath; plain everyday words.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生……蜜蜂……蜇了我……全身好痒……喉咙……好紧……
openingLine.en: Doctor… a bee… stung me… itchy all over… my throat's… so tight…

concerns.zh-CN: 我爸还在楼上病房等我。
concerns.en: My dad's waiting for me up on the ward.

concerns.zh-CN: 打完针我今天能回家吗？
concerns.en: Can I go home today after the injection?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 嘶哑、气促，每次2–4个词；不停抓挠手臂和脖子，一手捂喉；很害怕。平躺时说更喘一点。用药后说心跳得厉害、手抖，但呼吸逐渐轻松、说话越来越成句。不说出任何诊断名词；只有在被问到以前是否被蜇过/有无类似反应时才提去年的大局部反应；只有被问到接触蜜蜂的情况时才提公婆养蜂。
actingNotes.en: Hoarse and breathless, 2–4 words at a time; keeps scratching her arms and neck, one hand at her throat; frightened. When laid completely flat says breathing is a bit harder. After the injections says her heart is pounding and her hands are shaky, but breathing gets easier and her sentences get longer. Never names a diagnosis; mentions last year's large local reaction only when asked about previous stings/reactions, and her in-laws' bees only when asked about bee exposure.

label.zh-CN: 花园现场 · 初始评估

description.en: The emergency bag has arrived; no treatment given yet.

label.zh-CN: 花园现场 · 治疗后再评估

description.zh-CN: 首剂治疗已给予，仍在花园。
description.en: First-line treatment given; still in the garden.

label.zh-CN: 急诊抢救室 / 观察区

description.en: After transfer to the ED lying flat.

question.zh-CN: 发生了什么事？
question.en: What happened?

answer.zh-CN: 我坐在这儿……一只蜜蜂……蜇了我右胳膊……大概十来分钟前……
answer.en: I was sitting here… a bee… stung my right arm… ten minutes ago, maybe…

question.zh-CN: 被蜇后多久开始不舒服？症状是怎么发展的？
question.en: How soon after the sting did symptoms start, and how have they progressed?

answer.zh-CN: 就几分钟……先是痒……然后起一块块的包……嘴唇肿……再后来喉咙紧、喘不上气……一下子就重了……
answer.en: Within a couple of minutes… itching first… then the lumps… my lips swelled… then my throat and breathing… it got bad so fast…

question.zh-CN: 喉咙有没有发紧、吞咽困难或者声音变化？
question.en: Does your throat feel tight? Any trouble swallowing or change in your voice?

answer.zh-CN: 喉咙……像被掐住一样……咽口水都难……声音……变哑了……
answer.en: My throat… it's like it's squeezing shut… hard to swallow… my voice… gone croaky…

question.zh-CN: 有没有气短、胸闷或者喘的声音？
question.en: Are you short of breath? Any chest tightness or wheezing?

answer.zh-CN: 喘不上气……吸不满……胸口紧……我能听见自己在‘嘶嘶’地响……
answer.en: Can't… get a full breath… chest's tight… I can hear myself… whistling…

question.zh-CN: 有没有头晕、眼前发黑或者要晕倒的感觉？
question.en: Do you feel dizzy, light-headed or as if you might faint?

answer.zh-CN: 好晕……刚才想站起来……眼前一黑……又坐回去了……
answer.en: So dizzy… I tried to stand up… everything went grey… had to sit back down…

question.zh-CN: 刚才有没有失去意识？
question.en: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

answer.zh-CN: 没有……没晕过去……差一点……
answer.en: No… didn't pass out… nearly did…

question.zh-CN: 皮肤痒吗？有没有起疹子？从哪里开始的？
question.en: Is your skin itchy? Any rash — where did it start?

answer.zh-CN: 痒死了……先是胳膊……然后脖子、胸口、肚子……全是一块一块鼓起来的……
answer.en: So itchy… started on my arm… then my neck, chest, tummy… big raised lumps everywhere…

question.zh-CN: 嘴唇、舌头或者脸有没有肿？
question.en: Are your lips, tongue or face swollen?

answer.zh-CN: 嘴唇……好厚……舌头也胀……说话都不利索……
answer.en: My lips… feel huge… tongue's thick… hard to talk…

question.zh-CN: 有没有恶心、呕吐、肚子痛或者腹泻？
question.en: Any nausea, vomiting, tummy pain or diarrhoea?

answer.zh-CN: 有点恶心……肚子一阵一阵绞着疼……还没吐……没拉肚子……
answer.en: A bit sick… stomach cramping on and off… haven't vomited… no diarrhoea…

question.zh-CN: 有胸痛或者心慌吗？
question.en: Any chest pain or palpitations?

answer.zh-CN: 心跳得好快……不是痛……就是喘的那种紧……
answer.en: Heart's racing… not pain… just tight from the breathing…

question.zh-CN: 蜇在哪个部位？刺还在里面吗？
question.en: Where exactly were you stung? Is the sting still in?

answer.zh-CN: 右前臂这儿……那根刺好像还扎在里面……我没敢拔……
answer.en: Right forearm, here… I think the sting's still in… I didn't dare pull it out…

question.zh-CN: 是什么虫子蜇的？看清了吗？
question.en: What stung you — did you see the insect?

answer.zh-CN: 是蜜蜂……毛茸茸的，黄褐色……从那片薰衣草飞过来的……
answer.en: A bee… fuzzy, golden-brown… came from the lavender over there…

question.zh-CN: 被蜇前有没有吃过什么东西、吃过药、喝酒或者剧烈运动？
question.en: Before the sting, had you eaten anything, taken any medicine, drunk alcohol or exercised hard?

answer.zh-CN: 中午吃的米饭和青菜……都是平常吃的……今天没吃药，没喝酒……就从停车场走上来……
answer.en: Lunch at noon… rice and veg… nothing new… no tablets today, no alcohol… just walked up from the car park…

question.zh-CN: 以前被蜂蜇过吗？当时有什么反应？
question.en: Have you ever been stung before? How did you react?

answer.zh-CN: 去年夏天……脚踝被蜇过……不知道是蜜蜂还是马蜂……整条小腿又红又肿……好几天才消……那次没喘，也没全身起疹子……医生说是‘局部反应比较大’……没给我开过什么笔……
answer.en: Last summer… stung on the ankle… not sure if it was a bee or a wasp… my whole lower leg went red and swollen… took days to go down… no breathing trouble, no rash all over that time… the doctor called it a 'large local reaction'… nobody gave me any pen…

question.zh-CN: 以前做过过敏原检测吗？
question.en: Have you ever had allergy testing?

answer.zh-CN: 没做过……
answer.en: Never…

question.zh-CN: 对药物或者其他东西过敏吗？
question.en: Are you allergic to any medicines or anything else?

answer.zh-CN: 药……没有过敏……就是春天有花粉症……
answer.en: No… no drug allergies… just hay fever in spring…

question.zh-CN: 你身上带着肾上腺素自动注射笔吗？
question.en: Do you carry an adrenaline auto-injector?

answer.zh-CN: 没有……从来没人说我需要……
answer.en: No… nobody ever said I needed one…

question.zh-CN: 平时吃什么药吗？
question.en: Do you take any regular medicines?

answer.zh-CN: 就吃避孕药……每天一片……春天花粉症的时候吃西替利嗪……现在没在吃……
answer.en: Just the contraceptive pill… one a day… cetirizine in spring for hay fever… not taking it now…

question.zh-CN: 有没有吃降压药或心脏药，比如β受体阻滞剂或者ACEI类？
question.en: Do you take any blood-pressure or heart tablets, such as beta-blockers or ACE inhibitors?

answer.zh-CN: 没有……从来没吃过降压药或者心脏的药……
answer.en: No… never taken any blood pressure or heart tablets…

question.zh-CN: 有哮喘或者其他慢性病吗？
question.en: Do you have asthma or any other long-term condition?

answer.zh-CN: 十几岁时有过轻度哮喘……好多年没用过吸入剂了……还有花粉症……
answer.en: Mild asthma as a teenager… haven't used an inhaler for years… and hay fever…

question.zh-CN: 有没有心脏病、高血压、糖尿病之类的问题？
question.en: Any heart disease, high blood pressure or diabetes?

answer.zh-CN: 没有……一直挺健康的……
answer.en: No… I've always been healthy…

question.zh-CN: 做过手术吗？
question.en: Have you had any operations?

answer.zh-CN: 十二岁……割过阑尾……
answer.en: Appendix out… when I was twelve…

question.zh-CN: 有没有可能怀孕？末次月经是什么时候？
question.en: Could you be pregnant? When was your last period?

answer.zh-CN: 不会……我在吃避孕药……两周前来的月经……
answer.en: No… I'm on the pill… my period was two weeks ago…

question.zh-CN: 家里人有严重过敏的吗？
question.en: Does anyone in your family have severe allergies?

answer.zh-CN: 我妈有花粉症……没听说谁有过很严重的过敏……
answer.en: Mum has hay fever… nobody with bad reactions that I know of…

question.zh-CN: 你是做什么工作的？今天来医院做什么？
question.en: What do you do for work, and why are you at the hospital today?

answer.zh-CN: 我是中学音乐老师……今天来看我爸……他住在心内科病房……
answer.en: I teach music… at a secondary school… came to visit my dad… he's on the cardiology ward…

question.zh-CN: 抽烟喝酒吗？
question.en: Do you smoke or drink alcohol?

answer.zh-CN: 不抽烟……周末偶尔喝一杯红酒……今天没喝……
answer.en: Don't smoke… a glass of wine at weekends sometimes… none today…

question.zh-CN: 你和谁一起住？今晚有人陪你吗？
question.en: Who do you live with — is there someone who could be with you tonight?

answer.zh-CN: 和我爱人住……他在上班……打个电话他就能过来……
answer.en: I live with my husband… he's at work… he'd come if I call him…

question.zh-CN: 平时接触蜜蜂多吗？比如家里有人养蜂？
question.en: Are you often around bees — does anyone you know keep bees?

answer.zh-CN: 我公婆在乡下养了两箱蜜蜂……夏天的周末我们常去帮忙……
answer.en: My in-laws keep two beehives… out in the countryside… we go and help most summer weekends…

question.zh-CN: 还有其他不舒服吗？比如眼睛痒、流鼻涕、头痛？
question.en: Anything else — itchy eyes, runny nose, headache?

answer.zh-CN: 眼睛痒，一直流眼泪……鼻子有点堵……头有点胀……
answer.en: Eyes itchy and watering… nose a bit blocked… head feels full…

question.zh-CN: 你现在最担心的是什么？
question.en: What are you most worried about right now?

answer.zh-CN: 我……会不会憋死？……我爸还在楼上等我……
answer.en: Am I… going to choke?… my dad's waiting for me upstairs…

question.zh-CN: 你希望我们接下来怎么帮你？
question.en: What are you hoping we can do for you?

answer.zh-CN: 快让它停下来……弄好了我还能上去看我爸吗？……最好今天就回家……
answer.en: Just make it stop… can I go back up to dad afterwards?… I'd rather go home today…

question.zh-CN: 你上一次打破伤风疫苗是什么时候？
question.en: When did you last have a tetanus vaccination?

answer.zh-CN: 这个……我真不记得了……
answer.en: That… I really don't remember…

question.zh-CN: 你或者家里人有没有被诊断过肥大细胞增多症之类的病？
question.en: Have you or anyone in your family been diagnosed with mastocytosis or a mast-cell disorder?

answer.zh-CN: 没听说过这个病……不知道……
answer.en: Never heard of that… I don't know…

question.zh-CN: 你平时血压大概多少？
question.en: What is your blood pressure usually?

answer.zh-CN: 不知道……很少量血压……
answer.en: No idea… I hardly ever get it checked…

finding.zh-CN: 年轻女性前倾瘫坐在长椅上，面部潮红、神情惊恐，不停抓挠手臂和颈部，一只手捂着喉咙；声音嘶哑，每次只能说2–4个词。
finding.en: Young woman slumped forward on the bench, flushed and frightened, scratching her arms and neck, one hand at her throat; hoarse voice, speaking only 2–4 words at a time.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查气道（口唇、舌、口咽，听声音）
maneuver.en: Assess the airway (lips, tongue, oropharynx, voice)

finding.zh-CN: 上下唇明显肿胀（上唇为著），舌体肿大但能伸出，悬雍垂水肿；无流涎；声音嘶哑。静息时未闻及吸气性喘鸣。
finding.en: Marked swelling of both lips (upper > lower); tongue swollen but can protrude; uvula oedematous; no drooling; hoarse voice. No inspiratory stridor at rest.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺广泛多音调呼气相哮鸣音，呼气相延长；双侧呼吸音对称减低（双下肺为著）；未闻及湿啰音。
finding.en: Widespread polyphonic expiratory wheeze over both lungs with prolonged expiration; air entry reduced symmetrically, most at both bases; no crackles.

finding.zh-CN: 呼吸急促（约26次/分），胸锁乳突肌参与呼吸，无明显三凹征；能说短语但不能成句；口唇无发绀。
finding.en: Tachypnoeic (about 26/min) with sternocleidomastoid use; no marked recession; can speak phrases but not sentences; no central cyanosis.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查循环（桡动脉搏动、毛细血管再充盈、皮温）
maneuver.en: Assess circulation (radial pulse, capillary refill, peripheries)

finding.zh-CN: 桡动脉搏动快而细弱；胸骨处毛细血管再充盈时间约4秒；躯干潮红温暖，双手却湿冷。
finding.en: Radial pulse rapid and thready; central capillary refill about 4 s; trunk flushed and warm but hands cool and clammy.

finding.zh-CN: 全身泛发荨麻疹：颈、胸、腹、背及双上肢多发隆起、压之褪色、剧烈瘙痒的红色风团，部分融合成片；面部及前胸弥漫性潮红。
finding.en: Generalised urticaria: raised, blanching, intensely itchy red wheals over the neck, chest, abdomen, back and both arms, some coalescing; diffuse flushing of face and upper chest.

finding.zh-CN: 右前臂掌侧可见一枚连着毒囊的蜜蜂螫刺仍嵌在皮肤内，周围约3 cm红色风团，无出血。
finding.en: Volar right forearm: a honeybee stinger with its venom sac still embedded, surrounded by a 3 cm red wheal; no bleeding.

finding.zh-CN: 双侧结膜充血、流泪，眼睑轻度水肿；瞳孔等大等圆，对光反射灵敏。
finding.en: Bilateral conjunctival injection with tearing and mild eyelid swelling; pupils equal and reactive.

finding.zh-CN: 颈部外观无肿胀，气管居中，未见颈静脉充盈。
finding.en: No external neck swelling; trachea central; jugular venous pressure not visible.

finding.zh-CN: 心律齐，心动过速，心音有力，各瓣膜区未闻及杂音及心包摩擦音。
finding.en: Regular tachycardia; heart sounds normal; no murmurs or rub.

finding.zh-CN: 腹软，无膨隆，轻度弥漫性压痛，无反跳痛及肌紧张；肠鸣音活跃。
finding.en: Soft, not distended; mild diffuse tenderness without guarding or rebound; bowel sounds active.

maneuver.zh-CN: 神经系统 / 意识评估

finding.zh-CN: 首次评估：神志清楚，焦虑，定向力完整（AVPU：A；GCS 15）；四肢活动自如；言语清晰但嘶哑。
finding.en: At first check: alert and anxious, fully oriented (AVPU: A; GCS 15); moves all limbs; speech coherent though hoarse.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查随身物品（肾上腺素笔、医疗警示卡/手环）
maneuver.en: Check her belongings (auto-injector, medical alert card or bracelet)

finding.zh-CN: 手提包内有手机、钱包、钥匙和润唇膏；没有肾上腺素自动注射笔、吸入剂或医疗警示卡，手腕上也没有警示手环。
finding.en: Handbag contains a phone, purse, keys and lip balm; no adrenaline auto-injector, inhaler or medical alert card, and no alert bracelet.

finding.zh-CN: 仍平卧抬腿，较前安静，能说短句；面色好转，诉心跳‘咚咚’得厉害、手有点抖。
finding.en: Still lying with legs raised, calmer, managing short sentences; colour improved; says her heart is pounding and her hands are shaky.

finding.zh-CN: 口唇肿胀略有减轻但仍明显，舌体肿胀同前；声音仍嘶哑但较前有力；无喘鸣。
finding.en: Lip swelling slightly less tense but still marked; tongue swelling unchanged; voice still hoarse though stronger; no stridor.

finding.zh-CN: 双肺仍可闻及弥漫性呼气相哮鸣音，较前减轻；呼吸音较前改善。
finding.en: Diffuse expiratory wheeze still audible over both lungs, less than before; air entry improved.

finding.zh-CN: 桡动脉搏动较前有力但仍快；毛细血管再充盈约3秒；双手渐转暖。
finding.en: Radial pulse stronger but still fast; capillary refill about 3 s; hands warming.

maneuver.en: Reassess general appearance in the ED

finding.zh-CN: 平卧于抢救床，交谈自如，轻度手抖；自述‘舒服多了’。
finding.en: Lying on the resus trolley, talking comfortably, mild tremor; says she feels 'so much better'.

maneuver.en: Reassess the airway in the ED

finding.zh-CN: 口唇轻度残余肿胀，舌体大小正常，声音基本恢复，无喘鸣，吞咽唾液无困难。
finding.en: Mild residual lip swelling; tongue normal size; voice nearly normal; no stridor; swallowing saliva easily.

maneuver.en: Auscultate the chest in the ED

finding.zh-CN: 双肺呼吸音清，静息时无哮鸣音；用力呼气末偶闻少许哮鸣音。
finding.en: Good air entry bilaterally; no wheeze at rest; a few end-expiratory wheezes only on forced expiration.

maneuver.en: Re-examine the skin in the ED

finding.zh-CN: 风团明显消退，躯干残留淡红斑，无新发风团；右前臂蜇伤处螫刺已除，局部约4 cm红肿。
finding.en: Wheals largely resolved with faint residual erythema on the trunk and no new wheals; right-forearm sting site — stinger out, 4 cm local swelling.

examNotRecorded.zh-CN: 本病例未记录该项检查。花园里只有急救包——请先处理危及生命的问题。
examNotRecorded.en: Not recorded for this case. Only the emergency bag is available in the garden — deal with the life-threatening problems first.

text.zh-CN: 指尖血糖 6.4 mmol/L（急救包血糖仪，肾上腺素前）。
text.en: Capillary glucose 6.4 mmol/L (kit glucometer, before adrenaline).

text.zh-CN: 指尖血糖 7.3 mmol/L（急救包血糖仪，肾上腺素后）。
text.en: Capillary glucose 7.3 mmol/L (kit glucometer, after adrenaline).

text.zh-CN: 指尖血糖 7.7 mmol/L（急诊床旁）。
text.en: Capillary glucose 7.7 mmol/L (ED bedside).

name.zh-CN: 血清肥大细胞类胰蛋白酶（初始样本）

text.zh-CN: 初始样本（采于肾上腺素前，约症状出现后10分钟）：类胰蛋白酶 9.2 µg/L，在参考范围内。
text.en: Initial sample (drawn before adrenaline, ~10 min after onset): tryptase 9.2 µg/L, within the reference range.

note.zh-CN: 采血不应延误肾上腺素。样本过早，正常结果不能排除诊断。
note.en: Sampling must never delay adrenaline. This sample was too early — a normal value does not exclude the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 初始样本（复苏开始后经留置针采集，约症状出现后20分钟）：类胰蛋白酶 13.8 µg/L，升高。
text.en: Initial sample (taken from the cannula once resuscitation was under way, ~20 min after onset): tryptase 13.8 µg/L, raised.

note.zh-CN: 类胰蛋白酶在症状出现后约15–30分钟开始升高，1–2小时达峰，半衰期约2小时。早期样本正常不能排除过敏反应。需在完全恢复≥24小时后测基础值进行比较：急性值 >（1.2×基础值 + 2）µg/L 支持肥大细胞活化。本实验室批量检测，现实中报告可能需1–2天。
note.en: Tryptase starts to rise ~15–30 min after onset, peaks at 1–2 h and has a half-life of ~2 h. A normal early sample does not exclude anaphylaxis. Compare with a baseline taken ≥24 h after full recovery: an acute value > (1.2 × baseline + 2) µg/L supports mast-cell activation. Batched assay — in real life the report may take 1–2 days.

text.zh-CN: 初始样本（到急诊后采集，约症状出现后40分钟）：类胰蛋白酶 21.6 µg/L，升高。
text.en: Initial sample (taken on arrival in the ED, ~40 min after onset): tryptase 21.6 µg/L, raised.

name.zh-CN: 血清肥大细胞类胰蛋白酶（1–2小时定时样本）
name.en: Serum mast cell tryptase (timed 1–2 h sample)

text.zh-CN: 定时第二份样本（按流程于症状出现后1–2小时内采集）：类胰蛋白酶 27.4 µg/L，明显升高。
text.en: Timed second sample (drawn per protocol within 1–2 h of onset): tryptase 27.4 µg/L, clearly raised.

name.zh-CN: 静脉血气分析（含乳酸、电解质）
name.en: Venous blood gas (with lactate and electrolytes)

text.zh-CN: 静脉血气：轻度代谢性酸中毒伴乳酸升高（低灌注及肾上腺素β2效应），阴离子间隙 = Na −（Cl + HCO₃）= 139 −（106 + 19）= 14 mmol/L；血钾轻度降低（肾上腺素/沙丁胺醇致钾向细胞内转移）。静脉pO₂无解读意义。
text.en: Venous gas: mild metabolic acidosis with raised lactate (hypoperfusion plus β2 effect of adrenaline); anion gap = Na − (Cl + HCO₃) = 139 − (106 + 19) = 14 mmol/L; mildly low potassium (intracellular shift from adrenaline/salbutamol). Venous pO₂ is not interpretable. pCO₂ 5.0 kPa ≈ 37.5 mmHg.

text.zh-CN: 血常规基本正常，白细胞轻度升高（应激）。
text.en: Essentially normal; mild stress leucocytosis.

text.zh-CN: 血常规基本正常，白细胞轻度升高（应激）。
text.en: Essentially normal; mild stress leucocytosis.

text.zh-CN: 补液后血红蛋白轻度下降（稀释）；白细胞升高以中性粒细胞为主（肾上腺素致边缘池释放）。不改变处理。
text.en: Slightly lower haemoglobin after fluids (dilution); neutrophil leucocytosis (adrenaline-induced demargination). Does not change management.

text.zh-CN: 肾功能电解质正常。
text.en: Normal renal function and electrolytes.

text.zh-CN: 肾功能电解质正常。
text.en: Normal renal function and electrolytes.

text.zh-CN: 血钾轻度降低（肾上腺素/沙丁胺醇致钾向细胞内转移，通常自行恢复）；肾功能正常。
text.en: Mildly low potassium (intracellular shift from adrenaline/salbutamol, usually self-correcting); normal renal function.

text.zh-CN: 窦性心动过速，心率112次/分；电轴正常；PR 140 ms，QRS 84 ms，QTc 436 ms；无ST段偏移或T波改变；无早搏。
text.en: Sinus tachycardia 112/min; normal axis; PR 140 ms, QRS 84 ms, QTc 436 ms; no ST deviation or T-wave change; no ectopy.

note.zh-CN: 12导联心电图机在急诊；花园现场只有急救包。
note.en: The 12-lead ECG machine is in the ED; only the emergency bag is available in the garden.

text.zh-CN: 床旁前后位胸片：双肺野清晰，无实变、气胸或胸腔积液；心影及纵隔轮廓正常。
text.en: AP portable chest film: clear lung fields; no consolidation, pneumothorax or effusion; normal cardiomediastinal contour.

note.zh-CN: 过敏反应是临床诊断，胸片正常不改变处理。
note.en: Anaphylaxis is a clinical diagnosis; a normal chest film does not change management.

text.zh-CN: 未见肺动脉栓塞；双肺清晰；心脏大小正常。
text.en: No pulmonary embolism; clear lungs; normal heart size.

note.zh-CN: 无指征：在过敏反应观察期内将患者移出抢救区并注射碘对比剂，增加风险且延误观察，不改变诊断。
note.en: Not indicated: moving a patient out of resus during an anaphylactic reaction and giving iodinated contrast adds risk and interrupts observation without changing the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: hs-cTnT 5 ng/L（<14）。
text.en: hs-cTnT 5 ng/L (<14).

text.zh-CN: hs-cTnT 6 ng/L（<14）。
text.en: hs-cTnT 6 ng/L (<14).

note.zh-CN: 年轻、无胸痛者常规检测价值低；年长或有胸痛/心电图改变者（肾上腺素相关心肌缺血）才考虑。
note.en: Low yield in a young woman without chest pain; consider in older patients or with chest pain/ECG change after adrenaline.

text.zh-CN: CRP 2 mg/L（<5）。
text.en: CRP 2 mg/L (<5).

text.zh-CN: CRP 2 mg/L（<5）。
text.en: CRP 2 mg/L (<5).

text.zh-CN: 尿hCG 阴性。
text.en: Urine hCG negative.

text.zh-CN: 标本已送区域免疫实验室；结果待回（约3–5个工作日），将转交变态反应专科门诊。
text.en: Sample sent to the regional immunology laboratory; result pending (about 3–5 working days) and will go to the allergy clinic.

note.zh-CN: 急性期检测不改变处理；反应后数天内可能假阴性，阴性者需4–6周后复查。规范评估在变态反应专科完成。
note.en: Does not change acute management; may be falsely negative in the days after a reaction — repeat at 4–6 weeks if negative. Formal work-up belongs in the allergy clinic.

text.zh-CN: 标本已送区域免疫实验室；结果待回（约3–5个工作日），将转交变态反应专科门诊。
text.en: Sample sent to the regional immunology laboratory; result pending (about 3–5 working days) and will go to the allergy clinic.

note.zh-CN: 急性期检测不改变处理；反应后数天内可能假阴性，阴性者需4–6周后复查。规范评估在变态反应专科完成。
note.en: Does not change acute management; may be falsely negative in the days after a reaction — repeat at 4–6 weeks if negative. Formal work-up belongs in the allergy clinic.

name.zh-CN: 床旁超声（心脏/下腔静脉/肺）

text.zh-CN: 左心室高动力、收缩功能良好；右心室不大；无心包积液。下腔静脉内径1.4 cm，吸气塌陷>50%。双侧肺滑动存在，A线为主，无B线。
text.en: Hyperdynamic left ventricle with good systolic function; RV not dilated; no pericardial effusion. IVC 1.4 cm with >50% inspiratory collapse. Bilateral lung sliding with A-lines; no B-lines.

note.zh-CN: 符合分布性/低血容量状态，支持继续补液；不能代替临床评估。
note.en: Consistent with a distributive/under-filled state, supporting further fluid; it does not replace clinical assessment.

name.zh-CN: 呼救：启动医院急救小组
name.en: Call for help: activate the hospital emergency team

response.zh-CN: 你高声呼救，并让路过的保安拨打医院急救电话。护士周敏：‘急诊抢救小组已经出发，推床和带除颤功能的监护仪大约3–4分钟到。’
response.en: You shout for help and ask a passing security guard to ring the hospital emergency number. Nurse Zhou: 'The ED team is on its way — trolley and monitor-defibrillator in about 3–4 minutes.'

dose.zh-CN: 肾上腺素0.5 mg肌注（1 mg/mL [1:1000] 溶液0.5 mL），大腿中段前外侧；若无改善，5分钟后重复
dose.en: Adrenaline 0.5 mg IM (0.5 mL of 1 mg/mL [1:1000]) into the anterolateral mid-thigh; repeat after 5 min if no improvement

response.zh-CN: 护士复述：‘肾上腺素1 mg/mL，0.5 mL，肌注，大腿前外侧’，隔着裤子注射并记下时间。几分钟内她说心跳‘咚咚’得厉害、手发抖——这是预期的药物作用。5分钟后再评估A-B-C；若没有明显好转，重复同剂量。
response.en: The nurse reads back 'adrenaline 1 mg/mL, 0.5 mL, IM, anterolateral thigh', injects through her jeans and notes the time. Within minutes she says her heart is pounding and her hands are shaking — expected drug effects. Reassess A–B–C at 5 minutes; if not clearly better, repeat the same dose.

dose.zh-CN: 肾上腺素0.5 mg静脉推注（未稀释的1 mg/mL溶液0.5 mL）
dose.en: Adrenaline 0.5 mg IV bolus (0.5 mL of undiluted 1 mg/mL)

harm.zh-CN: 把肌注剂量（0.5 mg、1 mg/mL）直接静推可引起严重高血压、室性心律失常、心肌缺血、肺水肿甚至颅内出血。静脉肾上腺素只用于心脏骤停（1 mg），或由有经验的医生在持续监护下以稀释液滴定输注治疗难治性过敏反应。
harm.en: Pushing the IM dose (0.5 mg of 1 mg/mL) intravenously can cause severe hypertension, ventricular arrhythmias, myocardial ischaemia, pulmonary oedema and even intracranial haemorrhage. IV adrenaline is for cardiac arrest (1 mg) or as a dilute, titrated infusion by experienced clinicians with continuous monitoring for refractory anaphylaxis.

response.zh-CN: 护士迟疑地复述：‘未稀释的1 mg/mL，0.5 mL，静推？’你确认后推注。
response.en: The nurse hesitates: 'Undiluted 1 mg/mL, 0.5 mL, IV push?' You confirm and it is given.

dose.zh-CN: 肾上腺素0.5 mg皮下注射（上臂）

harm.zh-CN: 休克时皮下吸收慢且不可靠，血药浓度达峰明显延迟，达不到肌注的效果。应选择大腿前外侧肌内注射。
harm.en: In shock, subcutaneous absorption is slow and unreliable and peak levels are delayed — it does not achieve what IM injection does. Use the anterolateral thigh, intramuscularly.

response.zh-CN: 注射后几分钟内几乎没有变化。
response.en: Little changes over the next few minutes.

name.en: Lie her flat with legs raised

response.zh-CN: 你和护士扶她从长椅慢慢躺到铺在小路上的毯子上，双腿搭在长椅座面上抬高。她说头晕好一点，但完全平躺时更喘——护士在她肩下垫了叠好的外套，让头肩稍抬高、双腿仍保持抬高（低血压优先，兼顾呼吸）。
response.en: You and the nurse ease her off the bench onto a blanket on the path, legs resting up on the bench seat. The dizziness eases, but she is more breathless completely flat — the nurse slips a folded jacket under her shoulders so head and shoulders are slightly raised while the legs stay up (hypotension first, breathing accommodated).

name.en: Sit her upright or help her stand

harm.zh-CN: 低血压的过敏性休克患者坐起或站立会使静脉回流骤减（‘空心室’），可致晕厥甚至心脏骤停。以呼吸困难为主且血压正常者可以坐位；有低血压或头晕时应平卧抬腿（必要时头肩稍抬高）。
harm.en: Sitting or standing a hypotensive patient in anaphylaxis abruptly reduces venous return ('empty ventricle') and can cause collapse or cardiac arrest. Sitting up is fine for breathing problems with a normal blood pressure; with hypotension or dizziness, lie flat with legs raised (head and shoulders slightly up if needed).

response.zh-CN: 你扶她坐直。
response.en: You help her sit upright.

name.zh-CN: 扶她步行（或坐轮椅）去急诊
name.en: Walk her (or wheel her) to the Emergency Department

harm.zh-CN: 过敏反应患者不能步行或坐轮椅转运——突然直立可引起心脏骤停。应在现场先给予肌注肾上腺素，待推床到达后平卧、吸氧、持续监护下转运。
harm.en: A patient in anaphylaxis must not walk or be sat in a wheelchair — sudden uprightness can cause cardiac arrest. Give IM adrenaline where she is, then transfer lying flat on a trolley with oxygen and monitoring.

response.zh-CN: 她刚站起来就腿一软、眼前发黑，你和护士只好把她放回地上。
response.en: As she stands her legs buckle and she greys out; you and the nurse lower her back to the ground.

dose.zh-CN: 15 L/min 储氧面罩（便携氧气瓶），稳定后按SpO₂ 94–98% 调整
dose.en: 15 L/min via non-rebreather mask (portable cylinder); titrate to SpO₂ 94–98% once stable

response.zh-CN: 护士打开急救包里的便携氧气瓶，以15 L/min经储氧面罩给氧。
response.en: The nurse opens the portable cylinder from the bag and runs 15 L/min through a non-rebreather mask.

name.zh-CN: 持续监测（脉氧、自动血压、心电）

response.zh-CN: 便携脉氧夹上手指，自动血压计设为每3分钟测一次；急救小组到达后接上带除颤功能的监护仪（三导联心电）。
response.en: Portable pulse oximeter on, automated cuff cycling every 3 minutes; when the team arrives the monitor-defibrillator (3-lead ECG) is attached.

response.zh-CN: 你用卡片边缘把螫刺连同毒囊刮了出来，局部风团约3 cm。（蜇后几分钟毒液基本已注入——去除螫刺要快，但不能代替或延误全身治疗。）
response.en: You scrape the stinger and venom sac out with the edge of a card; 3 cm local wheal. (Most venom is delivered within the first minute — remove it fast, but it never replaces or delays systemic treatment.)

name.en: Peripheral IV access and blood sampling

dose.zh-CN: 18G外周留置针（肘前），可同时留取血标本
dose.en: 18G peripheral cannula (antecubital), taking blood samples at the same time

response.zh-CN: 护士在左肘前置入18G留置针，回抽血液留取标本。
response.en: The nurse places an 18G cannula in the left antecubital fossa and draws blood samples.

dose.zh-CN: 晶体液（复方乳酸钠或0.9%氯化钠）500–1000 mL 快速静滴（5–10分钟），每次后评估，按需重复
dose.en: Crystalloid (Hartmann's or 0.9% sodium chloride) 500–1000 mL rapid IV (over 5–10 min); reassess after each bolus and repeat as needed

response.zh-CN: 急救包里的晶体液加压快速输注。
response.en: The crystalloid from the bag runs in under a pressure cuff.

dose.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇5 mg 氧气驱动雾化（6–8 L/min），必要时重复
dose.en: Salbutamol 5 mg nebulised, oxygen-driven (6–8 L/min); repeat if needed

response.zh-CN: 沙丁胺醇5 mg 由便携氧气瓶驱动雾化。约10分钟后喘鸣减轻，她说‘胸口松一点了’，手抖更明显。（支气管扩张剂用于肾上腺素后仍持续的支气管痉挛，不能代替肾上腺素。）
response.en: Salbutamol 5 mg runs through the cylinder-driven nebuliser. Over about 10 minutes the wheeze eases — 'my chest's looser' — and her tremor increases. (A bronchodilator is for bronchospasm that persists after adrenaline; it never replaces adrenaline.)

name.zh-CN: 口服非镇静抗组胺药（西替利嗪）

dose.zh-CN: 西替利嗪10 mg 口服（能安全吞咽后）
dose.en: Cetirizine 10 mg orally (once she can swallow safely)

harm.zh-CN: 抗组胺药只缓解皮肤症状，不能治疗气道水肿、支气管痉挛或休克；在肾上腺素之前或代替肾上腺素使用会延误救命治疗。且舌肿、声音嘶哑时口服有误吸风险。
harm.en: Antihistamines only relieve skin symptoms; they do not treat airway oedema, bronchospasm or shock. Giving one before or instead of adrenaline delays life-saving treatment — and swallowing tablets with a swollen tongue and hoarse voice risks aspiration.

response.zh-CN: 她口服西替利嗪10 mg。瘙痒在随后一小时内逐渐减轻。（RCUK 2021：稳定后可用非镇静口服抗组胺药缓解皮肤症状——辅助治疗，非一线。）
response.en: She swallows cetirizine 10 mg; the itch settles over the next hour. (RCUK 2021: once stable, a non-sedating oral antihistamine may relieve skin symptoms — an adjunct, not first-line.)

dose.zh-CN: 氯苯那敏10 mg 缓慢静注（≥1分钟）
dose.en: Chlorphenamine 10 mg slow IV (over at least 1 min)

harm.zh-CN: 抗组胺药不是一线治疗：在肾上腺素之前使用会延误救命治疗；低血压时快速静注可加重低血压；其镇静作用还会干扰意识评估。指南更推荐稳定后口服非镇静抗组胺药。
harm.en: Not first-line: before adrenaline it delays life-saving treatment; rapid IV injection can worsen hypotension; and sedation clouds the assessment of conscious level. Guidelines now prefer an oral non-sedating antihistamine once stable.

response.zh-CN: 缓慢静注氯苯那敏10 mg。随后她有些犯困。
response.en: Chlorphenamine 10 mg given slowly IV; she becomes a little drowsy afterwards.

name.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素（氢化可的松静注）

dose.zh-CN: 氢化可的松200 mg 缓慢静注

harm.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素起效需数小时，不能治疗急性气道、呼吸、循环问题；在肾上腺素之前或代替肾上腺素使用会延误治疗。
harm.en: Corticosteroids take hours to act and do not treat acute airway, breathing or circulation problems; giving them before or instead of adrenaline delays treatment.

response.zh-CN: 静注氢化可的松200 mg。（RCUK 2021不推荐常规使用；仅在初始复苏后考虑用于难治性反应或持续的哮喘/休克。没有证据表明可预防双相反应。）
response.en: Hydrocortisone 200 mg IV given. (RCUK 2021 advises against routine use; consider only after initial resuscitation for refractory reactions or ongoing asthma/shock. There is no good evidence it prevents biphasic reactions.)

name.zh-CN: 平卧推床转运至急诊抢救室
name.en: Transfer to the ED resus bay on a trolley, lying flat

dose.zh-CN: 平卧、吸氧、持续监护、医护护送
dose.en: Lying flat, on oxygen, monitored, with doctor and nurse escort

harm.zh-CN: 尚未给予肌注肾上腺素就转运不稳定的患者会延误救命治疗——护士坚持先在现场给药，转运推迟到给药之后。
harm.en: Moving an unstable patient before IM adrenaline delays life-saving treatment — the nurse insists on giving it here first; transfer is deferred until after the injection.

response.zh-CN: 急救小组带推床赶到。她保持平卧、吸氧、持续监护，由你和护士护送约150米进入急诊抢救室。
response.en: The team arrives with the trolley. Lying flat, on oxygen and monitored, she is escorted about 150 m into the ED resus bay.

name.zh-CN: 急诊留观（症状缓解后至少6小时）
name.en: ED observation (at least 6 h after symptoms resolve)

response.zh-CN: 收入急诊观察区：持续监护，定时评估A-B-C及皮肤；因需两剂肾上腺素，症状完全缓解后至少观察6小时（如需再次给药或再次出现呼吸受累则延长至≥12小时）。
response.en: Admitted to the ED observation area: continuous monitoring with regular A–B–C and skin checks; because two doses of adrenaline were needed she stays at least 6 h after full resolution (≥12 h if another dose is needed or respiratory compromise recurs).

name.zh-CN: 开具2支肾上腺素自动注射笔并培训
name.en: Prescribe two adrenaline auto-injectors with training

dose.zh-CN: 2支成人肾上腺素自动注射笔（0.3 mg或0.5 mg，依当地处方集），随身携带；现场演示与回示；书面过敏反应应急计划
dose.en: Two adult adrenaline auto-injectors (0.3 mg or 0.5 mg per local formulary) to carry at all times; hands-on training with teach-back; written anaphylaxis action plan

response.zh-CN: 护士/药师用训练笔逐步示范并让她回示：出现症状→立即在大腿外侧注射→平躺（呼吸困难时可坐起）→呼叫急救→5分钟无改善用第二支。给她一份书面过敏反应应急计划。
response.en: The nurse/pharmacist demonstrates with a trainer pen and she teaches it back: symptoms → inject into the outer thigh at once → lie down (sit up if breathing is the problem) → call emergency services → second pen after 5 min if no better. She receives a written anaphylaxis action plan.

name.zh-CN: 转诊变态反应（过敏）专科
name.en: Refer to the specialist allergy clinic

response.zh-CN: 转诊变态反应专科：基础类胰蛋白酶（≥24小时后），约4–6周后行蜂毒特异性IgE/皮肤试验（必要时组分检测），评估蜂毒免疫治疗（公婆养蜂，暴露风险高）。
response.en: Referred to allergy: baseline tryptase (≥24 h after recovery), venom-specific IgE/skin tests at about 4–6 weeks (component testing if needed) and assessment for venom immunotherapy (in-laws keep bees — high exposure).

harm.zh-CN: 现在出院不安全：她需要两剂肾上腺素、且有明显呼吸受累，应在症状缓解后至少观察6小时；她没有肾上腺素笔、也未受培训；双相反应可在数小时后出现。
harm.en: Discharge now is unsafe: she needed two doses of adrenaline and had significant respiratory involvement, so she should be observed at least 6 h after resolution; she has no auto-injector and no training; a biphasic reaction can occur hours later.

response.zh-CN: 护士拦住了你：‘她还在观察期，而且身上没有肾上腺素笔。’
response.en: The nurse stops you: 'She's still in her observation window — and she has no auto-injector.'

message.zh-CN: 护士周敏举起已抽好的药：‘医生，血压还在往下掉——1 mg/mL的肾上腺素我准备好了，要给吗？’
message.en: Nurse Zhou holds up a drawn-up syringe: 'Doctor, her pressure is still falling — I've got the 1 mg/mL adrenaline ready. Do you want it?'

message.zh-CN: 她面色转为灰白，眼睛半闭，只能含糊应答；桡动脉几乎摸不到。护士：‘她快不行了！’
message.en: She turns grey, eyes half-closed, mumbling; the radial pulse is barely palpable. Nurse: 'We're losing her!'

message.zh-CN: 她重新睁开眼睛，能切题对答。
message.en: She opens her eyes and answers appropriately again.

message.zh-CN: 刚被扶起她就眼前发黑、向一侧歪倒，护士赶紧让她重新躺平。
message.en: As soon as she is upright she greys out and slumps sideways; the nurse quickly lays her flat again.

message.zh-CN: 推注后数秒她喊‘头要炸了’、捂住胸口；监护上出现成串室性早搏和短阵宽QRS心动过速，血压飙升。
message.en: Seconds after the push she cries 'my head's exploding' and clutches her chest; the monitor shows salvos of ventricular ectopics and short runs of broad-complex tachycardia, and the BP spikes.

message.zh-CN: 监护：窦性心律，心率已降到100次/分以下。
message.en: Monitor: sinus rhythm, rate now below 100/min.

message.zh-CN: 林女士说：‘我现在完全好了，疹子也快退没了——我能先上楼看看我爸，然后回家吗？’
message.en: Ms Lin: 'I feel completely fine now and the rash has nearly gone — can I pop up to see my dad and then go home?'

hint.zh-CN: 从气道开始：看口唇和舌、听声音；听双肺；摸桡动脉、看毛细血管再充盈；暴露皮肤。症状是否在接触可能的过敏原后几分钟内出现？
hint.en: Start with the airway: look at lips and tongue, listen to the voice; auscultate the chest; feel the radial pulse and check capillary refill; expose the skin. Did the symptoms start within minutes of a likely trigger?

guidance.zh-CN: 她在恶化。用一两分钟完成A-B-C-D-E快速评估，然后确认你的判断。
guidance.en: She is getting worse. Spend a minute or two on a rapid A–B–C–D–E, then commit to what this is.

hint.zh-CN: 先呼救。根据血压决定体位。一线药物是什么？剂量、浓度、途径和部位分别是什么？
hint.en: Call for help first. Let the blood pressure decide the position. What is the first-line drug — dose, concentration, route and site?

guidance.zh-CN: 呼救、摆体位、给予一线药物——不要等检查结果。
guidance.en: Call for help, position her, give the first-line drug — do not wait for any test.

title.zh-CN: 支持治疗与5分钟再评估

hint.zh-CN: 高流量吸氧、开放静脉并快速补液；记下给药时间，5分钟后再评估A-B-C。如果气道、呼吸或循环没有明显好转，下一步做什么？
hint.en: High-flow oxygen, IV access and a fluid bolus; note the time of the injection and reassess A–B–C after 5 minutes. If airway, breathing or circulation are not clearly better, what next?

guidance.zh-CN: 在等待药效的同时完成支持治疗，并在5分钟时系统再评估。
guidance.en: Complete supportive care while the drug works, then reassess systematically at 5 minutes.

title.zh-CN: 针对性病史、标本与转运

hint.zh-CN: 情况稳定后补问：既往蜇伤反应、哮喘、用药（尤其β受体阻滞剂/ACEI）、药物过敏、是否有肾上腺素笔。按时间采集类胰蛋白酶样本。平卧推床转运。
hint.en: Once she is stabilising, ask about previous sting reactions, asthma, medicines (especially beta-blockers/ACE inhibitors), drug allergies and whether she carries an auto-injector. Take timed tryptase samples. Transfer lying flat on a trolley.

guidance.zh-CN: 补全病史、留取定时标本、安全转运到急诊。
guidance.en: Fill in the history, take timed samples and transfer her safely to the ED.

hint.zh-CN: 需要几剂肾上腺素、有无严重呼吸受累，决定观察多久。出院前她需要带上什么、学会什么、转诊到哪里？
hint.en: How many doses were needed and how severe the breathing problem was determine how long she stays. Before she leaves, what must she carry, know and be referred to?

guidance.zh-CN: 决定观察时长，并为她准备安全出院。
guidance.en: Decide the observation period and prepare a safe discharge.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些表现共同支持林女士符合严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis）的临床诊断标准？（多选）
prompt.en: Which features together support a clinical diagnosis of anaphylaxis in Ms Lin? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先询问发生经过，并检查气道和双肺。
need.en: First ask what happened and examine the airway and chest.

text.zh-CN: 接触可能的过敏原（蜂蜇）后数分钟内急性起病
text.en: Acute onset within minutes of exposure to a likely allergen (bee sting)

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。暴露后数分钟到数小时内急性起病是所有诊断标准的前提；膜翅目毒液反应通常进展极快。
feedback.en: Correct. Acute onset minutes to hours after exposure underpins every criterion; venom reactions typically progress very fast.

text.zh-CN: 气道受累：口唇和舌肿胀、声音嘶哑、喉部发紧
text.en: Airway involvement: lip and tongue swelling, hoarse voice, throat tightness

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。声音嘶哑和喉部发紧提示喉头水肿——危及生命的气道问题。
feedback.en: Correct. Hoarseness and throat tightness signal laryngeal oedema — a life-threatening airway problem.

text.zh-CN: 呼吸受累：喘鸣、呼吸急促、SpO₂ 92%
text.en: Breathing involvement: wheeze, tachypnoea, SpO₂ 92%

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。支气管痉挛伴低氧属于呼吸受累。
feedback.en: Correct. Bronchospasm with hypoxaemia is breathing involvement.

text.zh-CN: 循环受累：收缩压<90 mmHg（78/44 mmHg）伴头晕
text.en: Circulatory involvement: systolic BP < 90 mmHg (78/44 mmHg) with dizziness

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。成人收缩压<90 mmHg（或较基础下降>30%）即为血压降低；伴头晕提示终末器官灌注不足——这就是过敏性休克。
feedback.en: Correct. In adults a systolic < 90 mmHg (or > 30% fall from baseline) is reduced BP; with dizziness it shows end-organ hypoperfusion — anaphylactic shock.

text.zh-CN: 皮肤黏膜受累：全身荨麻疹和潮红
text.en: Skin/mucosal involvement: generalised urticaria and flushing

feedback.zh-CN: 正确（支持性）。皮肤表现与气道/呼吸/循环问题同时出现即符合标准；但约10–20%的过敏反应没有皮疹，单纯荨麻疹也不等于过敏反应。
feedback.en: Correct (supportive). Skin features plus an airway/breathing/circulation problem meet the criteria — but 10–20% of anaphylaxis has no rash, and urticaria alone is not anaphylaxis.

text.zh-CN: 必须先等到类胰蛋白酶升高才能确诊
text.en: A raised tryptase is needed before the diagnosis can be made

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。过敏反应是临床诊断；类胰蛋白酶数小时后才回报、早期可正常，只用于事后佐证。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Anaphylaxis is a clinical diagnosis; tryptase takes hours, may be normal early and only supports the diagnosis afterwards.

text.zh-CN: 去年的‘大局部反应’本身就是诊断标准之一
text.en: Last year's large local reaction is itself one of the diagnostic criteria

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。既往大局部反应不是诊断标准，此后发生全身反应的风险也较低（约4–10%）。诊断依据的是这一次的表现。
feedback.en: Incorrect. A previous large local reaction is not a criterion, and the later risk of a systemic reaction is low (about 4–10%). The diagnosis rests on today's features.

prompt.zh-CN: 现在最重要的一线药物治疗是什么？
prompt.en: What is the immediate first-line drug treatment?

need.zh-CN: 先询问发生经过，并检查气道和双肺。
need.en: First ask what happened and examine the airway and chest.

text.zh-CN: 肾上腺素0.5 mg肌注（1 mg/mL溶液0.5 mL），大腿中段前外侧；5分钟无改善则重复
text.en: Adrenaline 0.5 mg IM (0.5 mL of 1 mg/mL) into the anterolateral mid-thigh; repeat after 5 min if no improvement

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。肌注大腿前外侧吸收最快且安全；成人及>12岁儿童剂量0.5 mg。可隔衣注射，不要为采血、建立静脉或找监护仪而延误。
feedback.en: Correct. IM into the anterolateral thigh is fastest-absorbed and safe; 0.5 mg for adults and children over 12. Inject through clothing if needed — never delay it for bloods, IV access or a monitor.

text.zh-CN: 肾上腺素0.5 mg静脉推注
text.en: Adrenaline 0.5 mg IV bolus

feedback.zh-CN: 错误且危险。静推肌注剂量可致严重高血压、室性心律失常和心肌缺血。静脉肾上腺素仅用于心脏骤停或由专家在监护下稀释滴注。
feedback.en: Incorrect and dangerous. An IV bolus of the IM dose can cause severe hypertension, ventricular arrhythmias and myocardial ischaemia. IV adrenaline is for cardiac arrest or a dilute expert-titrated infusion.

text.zh-CN: 氯苯那敏10 mg静注加氢化可的松200 mg静注
text.en: Chlorphenamine 10 mg IV plus hydrocortisone 200 mg IV

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。二者都不能治疗气道水肿、支气管痉挛或休克；以它们代替肾上腺素是过敏反应死亡的常见可避免因素。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Neither treats airway oedema, bronchospasm or shock; using them instead of adrenaline is a classic avoidable factor in anaphylaxis deaths.

text.zh-CN: 肾上腺素0.5 mg皮下注射
text.en: Adrenaline 0.5 mg subcutaneously

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。皮下吸收慢且不可靠（休克时更甚），应肌注。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Subcutaneous absorption is slow and unreliable, especially in shock — give it IM.

text.zh-CN: 先雾化沙丁胺醇，无效再考虑肾上腺素
text.en: Nebulised salbutamol first, adrenaline only if that fails

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。沙丁胺醇只针对支气管痉挛，不能治疗喉头水肿和休克；它是肾上腺素之后的辅助治疗。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Salbutamol treats only bronchospasm, not laryngeal oedema or shock; it is an adjunct after adrenaline.

text.zh-CN: 肾上腺素1:10 000（0.1 mg/mL）溶液0.5 mL肌注
text.en: Adrenaline 1:10,000 (0.1 mg/mL) solution, 0.5 mL IM

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。这只有0.05 mg——剂量不足10倍。肌注必须用1 mg/mL（1:1000）溶液；0.1 mg/mL只用于心脏骤停静脉给药。
feedback.en: Incorrect. That is only 0.05 mg — a ten-fold underdose. IM injection uses 1 mg/mL (1:1000); 0.1 mg/mL is for IV use in cardiac arrest.

prompt.zh-CN: 林女士在急诊症状已基本缓解，并要求回家。最合适的处理是？
prompt.en: Ms Lin's symptoms have largely settled in the ED and she asks to go home. What is the most appropriate plan?

need.zh-CN: 先给予肾上腺素并将她转运至急诊。
need.en: First give adrenaline and transfer her to the ED.

text.zh-CN: 症状缓解后至少观察6小时（如需再次给药或再次呼吸受累则≥12小时），出院时带2支肾上腺素自动注射笔并完成培训、书面应急计划，转诊变态反应专科
text.en: Observe for at least 6 h after symptoms resolve (≥12 h if a further dose is needed or respiratory compromise recurs); discharge with two adrenaline auto-injectors, training and a written action plan, and refer to the allergy clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。需要两剂肾上腺素→至少观察6小时（RCUK 2021）；双相反应多发生在12小时内。出院必须带2支笔、会用、有书面计划，并转诊评估蜂毒免疫治疗。
feedback.en: Correct. Two adrenaline doses → at least 6 h observation (RCUK 2021); biphasic reactions mostly occur within 12 h. She must leave with two pens, know how to use them, have a written plan and be referred for venom immunotherapy assessment.

text.zh-CN: 症状已消失，观察满2小时即可出院，让社区医生以后转诊
text.en: Symptoms have resolved — discharge after 2 h, GP to refer later

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。2小时快速出院仅适用于：起病30分钟内单剂肾上腺素即迅速好转、症状完全缓解、已有未使用的笔并会用、出院后有人照看。她需要两剂且没有笔。
feedback.en: Incorrect. 2-hour fast-track discharge is only for a good response to a single dose given within 30 min of onset, full resolution, unused pens already held and trained, and supervision at home. She needed two doses and has no pens.

text.zh-CN: 出院带3天口服泼尼松龙和氯苯那敏，不需要肾上腺素笔
text.en: Discharge with 3 days of oral prednisolone and chlorphenamine; no auto-injector needed

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。激素和抗组胺药都不能预防或治疗再次发生的过敏反应；她需要肾上腺素笔。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Steroids and antihistamines neither prevent nor treat a further reaction; she needs auto-injectors.

text.zh-CN: 收入ICU观察48小时，并预防性静脉用激素和抗组胺药
text.en: Admit to ICU for 48 h with prophylactic IV steroids and antihistamines

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。她已稳定，无需ICU；预防性激素/抗组胺药没有预防双相反应的可靠证据。
feedback.en: Incorrect. She is stable and does not need ICU; prophylactic steroids/antihistamines have no reliable evidence for preventing biphasic reactions.

text.zh-CN: 开1支肾上腺素笔回家备用；只是蜂蜇，不需要专科随访
text.en: One auto-injector to keep at home; it was only a bee sting, so no specialist follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 错误。应开2支并随身携带（第一支可能无效或需再次用药）；蜂毒过敏者需专科评估蜂毒免疫治疗，可显著降低再次全身反应风险。
feedback.en: Incorrect. Prescribe two and carry them at all times (a second dose may be needed); venom-allergic patients need specialist assessment for venom immunotherapy, which markedly lowers the risk of future systemic reactions.

text.zh-CN: 询问既往蜇伤反应史
text.en: Asked about previous sting reactions

text.zh-CN: 询问用药（含β受体阻滞剂/ACEI）及药物过敏史
text.en: Asked about medicines (including beta-blockers/ACE inhibitors) and drug allergies

text.zh-CN: 快速评估气道、呼吸与循环
text.en: Rapidly assessed airway, breathing and circulation

text.zh-CN: 识别过敏反应的临床诊断标准
text.en: Recognised the clinical criteria for anaphylaxis

text.zh-CN: 5分钟内肌注肾上腺素0.5 mg（1 mg/mL）于大腿前外侧
text.en: IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (1 mg/mL) into the anterolateral thigh within 5 minutes

text.zh-CN: 5分钟再评估无明显改善时重复肌注肾上腺素
text.en: Repeated IM adrenaline when the 5-minute reassessment showed inadequate response

text.zh-CN: 呼救并让低血压患者平卧抬腿
text.en: Called for help and laid the hypotensive patient flat with legs raised

text.zh-CN: 高流量吸氧、晶体液扩容，并在肾上腺素后对持续喘鸣使用沙丁胺醇
text.en: High-flow oxygen, crystalloid bolus, and salbutamol for wheeze persisting after adrenaline

text.zh-CN: 未静脉推注或皮下注射肾上腺素
text.en: Avoided IV-bolus and subcutaneous adrenaline

text.zh-CN: 未让低血压患者坐起、站立或步行
text.en: Did not sit up, stand or walk the hypotensive patient

text.zh-CN: 采集定时肥大细胞类胰蛋白酶（初始 + 1–2小时）
text.en: Took timed mast cell tryptase samples (initial + 1–2 h)

text.zh-CN: 安排≥6小时观察、2支肾上腺素自动注射笔及变态反应专科转诊
text.en: Arranged ≥6 h observation, two auto-injectors and allergy referral

text.zh-CN: 用简短平静的语言向患者解释与安慰
text.en: Explained and reassured in short, calm sentences

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 在不拖延治疗的前提下，用简短句子告诉她发生了什么、将做什么（大腿打针，之后会心慌、手抖）；回应她‘会不会憋死’的担心；征得口头同意。
judgeGuidance.en: Without delaying treatment, tells her in short sentences what is happening and what will be done (an injection in the thigh; she may feel her heart pound and hands shake); addresses her fear of choking; obtains verbal consent.

text.zh-CN: 与护士闭环沟通给药医嘱
text.en: Closed-loop drug communication with the nurse

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 医嘱明确药名、浓度（1 mg/mL）、剂量（0.5 mg = 0.5 mL）、途径和部位；要求复述确认；记录给药时间以便5分钟后再评估。
judgeGuidance.en: States drug, concentration (1 mg/mL), dose (0.5 mg = 0.5 mL), route and site; asks for read-back; notes the time so the 5-minute reassessment happens.

text.zh-CN: 出院宣教与安全网
text.en: Discharge counselling and safety-netting

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 解释观察原因与双相反应风险；演示并让她回示自动注射笔用法；两支随身携带；出现症状立即注射、平躺、呼叫急救；书面应急计划；转诊变态反应专科及蜂毒免疫治疗的意义；告知公婆家养蜂的暴露风险。
judgeGuidance.en: Explains why she is observed and the biphasic risk; demonstrates the auto-injector with teach-back; carry both pens; inject at once, lie down and call emergency services; written action plan; allergy referral and what venom immunotherapy offers; addresses bee exposure at her in-laws'.

knowledge.zh-CN: 我是心内科病房护士周敏，刚好在花园，听见呼救就带着病区急救包跑过来了。到场时测得：血压78/44 mmHg，心率128次/分，呼吸26次/分，SpO₂ 92%（空气）。急救包里有：肾上腺素1 mg/mL（1:1000）安瓿×5，1 mL和2 mL注射器与针头；便携氧气瓶（最高15 L/min）、储氧面罩和雾化面罩；简易呼吸器；18G/20G留置针、采血管和止血带；晶体液（复方乳酸钠、0.9%氯化钠）500 mL×2袋及输液器、加压袋；沙丁胺醇雾化液5 mg；西替利嗪10 mg片；氯苯那敏10 mg注射液；氢化可的松100 mg×2；便携脉氧仪、自动血压计、血糖仪；手套、毯子。没有除颤仪、吸引器和心电图机——要等医院急救小组带推床过来（呼叫后约3–4分钟），或回急诊。急诊离花园约150米。心电图机、影像和血气分析仪都在急诊，抽的血可以送检验科。我会复述每条医嘱（药名、浓度、剂量、途径、部位）并记录给药时间；不确定的医嘱我会提出疑问。我不做诊断。
knowledge.en: I'm Zhou Min, a cardiology ward nurse. I was in the garden, heard the shout and ran over with the ward emergency bag. On arrival: BP 78/44 mmHg, HR 128/min, RR 26/min, SpO₂ 92% on air. The bag has: adrenaline 1 mg/mL (1:1000) ampoules ×5, 1 mL and 2 mL syringes and needles; a portable oxygen cylinder (up to 15 L/min) with non-rebreather and nebuliser masks; a bag-valve-mask; 18G/20G cannulas, blood tubes and tourniquet; crystalloid (Hartmann's, 0.9% sodium chloride) 500 mL ×2 with giving sets and a pressure bag; salbutamol nebules 5 mg; cetirizine 10 mg tablets; chlorphenamine 10 mg injection; hydrocortisone 100 mg ×2; portable pulse oximeter, automated BP cuff and glucometer; gloves and a blanket. No defibrillator, suction or ECG machine — those come with the hospital emergency team and trolley (about 3–4 min after the call) or in the ED, about 150 m away. The ECG machine, imaging and the blood-gas analyser are in the ED; blood samples can go to the lab. I read back every order (drug, concentration, dose, route, site) and note the time; I will question an order I'm unsure about. I don't make diagnoses.

name.zh-CN: 急诊科主治医师 高岩

knowledge.zh-CN: 随急救小组到场后接手指导。以苏格拉底式提问引导：你依据哪些表现做出判断？为什么选这个途径和部位？5分钟后如何判断是否需要重复？低血压和呼吸困难并存时如何摆体位？抗组胺药和激素放在什么位置？观察多久、出院前需要什么？不直接给出答案，只依据病例中已有的发现讨论。
knowledge.en: Arrives with the emergency team and supervises. Teaches Socratically: which features support your judgement? Why this route and site? How do you decide at 5 minutes whether to repeat? How do you position someone who is both hypotensive and breathless? Where do antihistamines and steroids fit? How long do you observe, and what must she have before going home? Does not hand out answers; discusses only findings already in the case.

name.zh-CN: 变态反应科会诊医师 沈医生（电话）

knowledge.zh-CN: 可在学员已拿到结果后解读类胰蛋白酶与蜂毒特异性IgE：类胰蛋白酶在1–2小时达峰，早期样本可正常；需在完全恢复≥24小时后测基础值，急性值 >（1.2×基础值 + 2）µg/L 支持肥大细胞活化，基础值持续升高需排查肥大细胞疾病。特异性IgE反应后数天可假阴性，阴性者4–6周后复查；皮肤试验在专科进行。成人蜂毒所致超出皮肤症状的全身反应且致敏证实者，推荐蜂毒免疫治疗。专科门诊可在4–6周内安排。
knowledge.en: Interprets tryptase and venom-specific IgE once the learner has the results: tryptase peaks at 1–2 h and an early sample may be normal; a baseline ≥24 h after full recovery is needed — an acute value > (1.2 × baseline + 2) µg/L supports mast-cell activation, and a persistently raised baseline prompts work-up for a mast-cell disorder. Specific IgE can be falsely negative in the first days — repeat at 4–6 weeks if negative; skin testing is done in clinic. Adults with systemic sting reactions beyond the skin and confirmed sensitisation should be offered venom immunotherapy. Clinic can see her within 4–6 weeks.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解读学员已获得的影像：胸片正常；CT肺动脉造影无栓塞。会指出在过敏反应观察期内做增强CT缺乏指征。
knowledge.en: Interprets only imaging the learner already has: normal chest film; CTPA without embolism. Will point out that contrast CT during an anaphylaxis observation period lacks an indication.

knowledge.zh-CN: 负责肾上腺素自动注射笔的处方核对与使用培训：开2支、随身携带、注意有效期；用训练笔示范并要求回示；大腿外侧注射，可隔衣；用后平躺、呼叫急救，5分钟无改善用第二支；提供书面过敏反应应急计划。不讨论诊断。
knowledge.en: Checks the auto-injector prescription and trains her: two pens, carried at all times, watch the expiry date; trainer-pen demonstration with teach-back; inject into the outer thigh, through clothing if needed; then lie down and call emergency services, second pen after 5 min if no better; provides a written anaphylaxis action plan. Does not discuss the diagnosis.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：花园蜂蜇后的严重过敏反应
title.en: Debrief: anaphylaxis after a bee sting in the garden

conclusion.zh-CN: 蜜蜂（膜翅目）毒液所致严重过敏反应（anaphylaxis），同时累及气道（口唇/舌血管性水肿、声音嘶哑）、呼吸（支气管痉挛，SpO₂ 92%）和循环（血压78/44 mmHg、头晕）——即过敏性休克。在现场给予肌注肾上腺素0.5 mg（1 mg/mL）于大腿前外侧并于5分钟再评估后重复、平卧抬腿、高流量吸氧、晶体液扩容及沙丁胺醇雾化后好转，平卧转运至急诊。类胰蛋白酶由初始样本的13.8 µg/L升至1–2小时样本的27.4 µg/L，支持肥大细胞活化。处置：症状缓解后至少观察6小时，出院带2支肾上腺素自动注射笔并完成培训和书面应急计划，转诊变态反应专科评估蜂毒免疫治疗。
conclusion.en: Severe honeybee (Hymenoptera) venom anaphylaxis involving airway (lip/tongue angio-oedema, hoarseness), breathing (bronchospasm, SpO₂ 92%) and circulation (BP 78/44 mmHg with dizziness) — anaphylactic shock. She improved on scene with IM adrenaline 0.5 mg (1 mg/mL) into the anterolateral thigh, repeated after the 5-minute reassessment, lying flat with legs raised, high-flow oxygen, a crystalloid bolus and nebulised salbutamol, and was transferred lying flat to the ED. Tryptase rose from 13.8 µg/L (initial) to 27.4 µg/L (1–2 h sample), supporting mast-cell activation. Disposition: observation for at least 6 h after resolution, discharge with two adrenaline auto-injectors, training and a written action plan, and referral to allergy for venom immunotherapy assessment.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诊断是临床的：接触可能的过敏原后急性起病，加上气道和/或呼吸和/或循环问题（通常伴皮肤改变）。不必等血压阈值或类胰蛋白酶。
keyReasoning.en: The diagnosis is clinical: sudden onset after a likely allergen with airway and/or breathing and/or circulation problems (usually with skin changes). Do not wait for a BP threshold or a tryptase.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肌注肾上腺素是唯一的一线药物：成人0.5 mg = 1 mg/mL溶液0.5 mL，大腿前外侧；5分钟无改善就重复。两剂后仍无改善即难治性过敏反应，需专家协助启动肾上腺素静脉输注。
keyReasoning.en: IM adrenaline is the only first-line drug: adults 0.5 mg = 0.5 mL of 1 mg/mL into the anterolateral thigh, repeated after 5 min if no better. No improvement after two doses = refractory anaphylaxis → expert help and an adrenaline infusion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 体位由血压决定：低血压/头晕→平卧抬腿；呼吸困难为主→可坐起；两者并存时头肩稍抬高、腿保持抬高。绝不能让休克患者坐起、站立或步行（‘空心室’可致心脏骤停）。
keyReasoning.en: Position follows the blood pressure: hypotension/dizziness → flat with legs raised; breathing problems → may sit up; both → head and shoulders slightly up, legs still raised. Never sit up, stand or walk a shocked patient ('empty ventricle' can cause arrest).

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 支持治疗与肾上腺素并行：高流量吸氧、晶体液500–1000 mL快速输注、肾上腺素后仍喘鸣时加用支气管扩张剂。抗组胺药（稳定后口服非镇静类）和激素只是辅助，激素不常规使用。
keyReasoning.en: Supportive care runs alongside adrenaline: high-flow oxygen, a 500–1000 mL crystalloid bolus, and a bronchodilator for wheeze persisting after adrenaline. Antihistamines (oral non-sedating, once stable) and steroids are adjuncts; steroids are not routine.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 去向取决于严重度和所需剂量：两剂肾上腺素→症状缓解后至少观察6小时；>2剂、严重哮喘/呼吸受累、深夜就诊等→≥12小时。她不符合2小时快速出院标准（两剂、无笔）。
keyReasoning.en: Disposition depends on severity and doses: two doses → at least 6 h after resolution; > 2 doses, severe asthma/respiratory compromise or late-night presentation → ≥ 12 h. She does not meet 2-hour fast-track criteria (two doses, no pens).

boundaries.zh-CN: 本教学脚本简化了生理（药物效应线性起效、到时即止）并压缩了时间；剂量仅适用于成人及>12岁儿童（RCUK 2021肌注剂量：6–12岁0.3 mg，6个月–6岁0.15 mg，<6个月0.1–0.15 mg）。不能代替当地流程和专科意见。
boundaries.en: This teaching script simplifies physiology (linear drug effects with instant offset) and compresses time; doses apply to adults and children over 12 only (RCUK 2021 IM doses: 6–12 y 0.3 mg, 6 months–6 y 0.15 mg, < 6 months 0.1–0.15 mg). It does not replace local protocols or specialist advice.

unknowns.zh-CN: 基础类胰蛋白酶（需在完全恢复≥24小时后检测）
unknowns.en: Baseline tryptase (needs a sample ≥24 h after full recovery)

unknowns.zh-CN: 蜂毒特异性IgE结果（送检中）

unknowns.en: Which insect caused last year's sting

teachingPoints.zh-CN: ‘IM，大腿，1 mg/mL，0.5 mL’——把这句话说出口，让护士复述，并记下时间。
teachingPoints.en: 'IM, thigh, 1 mg/mL, 0.5 mL' — say it aloud, get a read-back, note the time.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 类胰蛋白酶：复苏开始后尽早采第一份（不延误治疗），1–2小时（不迟于4小时）采第二份，≥24小时后采基础值；早期正常不能排除诊断。
teachingPoints.en: Tryptase: first sample as soon as feasible once resuscitation is under way (never delaying it), a second at 1–2 h (no later than 4 h), and a baseline ≥ 24 h after recovery; a normal early value does not exclude anaphylaxis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 双相反应：约5%（文献1–20%），多在12小时内；严重初始反应和需多剂肾上腺素者风险更高。预防性激素/抗组胺药不能可靠预防。
teachingPoints.en: Biphasic reactions: about 5% (reported 1–20%), mostly within 12 h; more likely after severe initial reactions or when several adrenaline doses were needed. Prophylactic steroids/antihistamines do not reliably prevent them.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 出院清单：2支自动注射笔（随身携带）、回示培训、书面应急计划、变态反应专科转诊；告知风险因素（哮喘、β受体阻滞剂/ACEI、运动/酒精/NSAID等辅因子）。
teachingPoints.en: Discharge checklist: two auto-injectors carried at all times, teach-back training, written action plan, allergy referral; discuss risk modifiers (asthma, beta-blockers/ACE inhibitors, cofactors such as exercise, alcohol and NSAIDs).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 蜂毒免疫治疗显著降低再次全身反应的风险；高暴露者（如家人养蜂）尤其获益。
teachingPoints.en: Venom immunotherapy markedly lowers the risk of future systemic reactions — especially valuable with high exposure (e.g. family beekeepers).

authoringNotes.physiology: Two trend families per vital: '*-early' stop at the first IM adrenaline dose, '*-persisting' only at the second, so a single dose gives a partial response (SBP ~86 at the 5-minute reassessment) and the second dose is genuinely indicated. Each IM dose adds a persistent component (resolution) and a 15-min transient component (peak effect). Untreated, SBP reaches ~58 at 10 min (peri-arrest event).
authoringNotes.phases: Live progression (simulated clock): scene → treated (first IM adrenaline) → ed (IM adrenaline + transfer). Phase-specific exam findings model reassessment; ECG/imaging/blood gas exist only in the ED phase.
